verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents querying data directly from S3, GCS and Azure Blob Storage without loading it first, with stored S3 credentials via CREATE SECRET. It also offers DuckLake, an open lakehouse format that can sit on the user's own object storage. However, nothing in the evidence names Iceberg, Delta or Parquet as supported formats. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Iceberg and Delta table reading, explicit Parquet-in-object-storage querying, independent or hands-on corroboration.
